stages.gate: Independent examples built against documented API artifacts
Stable identities, parallel elements, safe topology and native wire persistence
Electrical models, accuracy, exactly-once history and solver ownership on both backends
Wiring, meters, panel and board workflows with actual players
Cold restart, actual unload cycles and recoverable fault isolation
Eight-way packaged acceptance, independent SDK, real clients and frozen publication artifacts

abi_baseline: First public API release: establish snapshot; no previous public contract exists

pending_retirement_restart.finding: Native saved-entity deserialization can run synchronously on the server thread before entity readiness; the entity-deserializer thread name alone does not establish worker ownership
pending_retirement_restart.correction: Defer discovery on background threads and binding until API endpoints are ready; preserve exact old wire identities across a save made before readiness

remaining: Repeat the save-before-ready SETUP/ARM/VERIFY gate on the final eight-way frozen-artifact matrix
Complete fresh Java verification and actual graphical/multiplayer workflows
Run packaged acceptance against frozen runtime/API/example artifacts
Retain actual build and gameplay evidence for every release gate
Freeze API 1.0.0 and publish only after all six gates pass
